role_separation.WORKER: May write only active child academic/status artifacts; cannot self-accept or unlock successor.
role_separation.DIRECTOR: May open windows, independently review, accept or require repair, and update control-plane governance; does not replace worker authoring.
role_separation.SENTINEL: Read-only for academic/control-plane state; may write only Sentinel checkpoint/status; cannot accept or unlock.
role_separation.ORCHESTRATOR: Reads durable state, validates invariants, plans and dispatches the next role; never changes academic truth by itself.

agent_runner.fallback_when_unconfigured: Create idempotent GitHub issue containing the run request JSON.
